A '''baked golden apple''' is the simple preparation of the [[golden apple]], a secret [[ingredient]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Absorption}} for 2 minutes and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_golden_apple.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A golden apple cooks into a baked golden apple in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked golden apple takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Absorption I for 2:00 and Regeneration I for 1:00. The tooltip says Regeneration lasts 0:30, but the effect is 1200 ticks (1:00).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_golden_apple.json}}</ref>

Baked golden apples make [[canned golden apples]] and the [[gilded empanada]]. Cooking one grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
